title: The Bellaire Pub & Beer Garden
new_html:
Short’s Brewing Company’s Bellaire Pub is a vibrant brewpub located in the heart of downtown Bellaire, Michigan, at 121 N Bridge St. Housed in a historic building, the pub offers a warm and inviting atmosphere where guests can enjoy a wide selection of craft beers brewed on-site, including classics like Local’s Light and Huma Lupa Licious. The menu features a variety of house-made dishes, from pretzels to pizzas, complemented by a curated list of ciders and seltzers.

Just across the street, you’ll find the lively Beer Garden (118 N Bridge St., Bellaire, MI 49615), perfect for soaking up Bellaire’s charming vibe. It’s a seasonal outdoor venue that hosts live music during the summer months.

Phone: (231) 498-2300

Pub Hours:
Sunday–Tuesday: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM
Wednesday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
Thursday: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM
Friday–Saturday: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM

Hours change seasonally and on holidays, so check the website before you go.

title: The Bellaire Pub - Guided Brewery Tour
new_html:
Ever wondered what goes into crafting your favorite Short’s brew? Now’s your chance to find out! Short’s Brewing Company offers behind-the-scenes tours of the innovation brewery at their Bellaire Pub, giving you an insider’s look at the brewing process from start to finish.

Website: https://www.shortsbrewing.com/tours/

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hB_pr3V0KfA

Tour Highlights:

  • When: Fridays and Saturdays, from 12:00 PM to 4:00 PM. No reservations or call-aheads—simply check in at the host stand when you arrive.
  • What to Expect: A guided walk through the innovation brewery where you’ll learn about the brewing process, the history of Short’s, and the artistry behind their unique beers.
  • Note: Tours are only offered at the Bellaire Pub. The Elk Rapids production campus no longer runs tours.

Pro Tips:

  • Arrive Early: Tours are popular, so arriving a bit early ensures you don’t miss out.
  • Stay for a Pint: After the tour, enjoy a freshly poured pint of your favorite Short’s brew in the cozy pub or, in summer, the lively beer garden.
  • Ask Questions: The staff are passionate about their craft and love sharing their knowledge. Don’t hesitate to ask about the brewing process, ingredients, or the inspiration behind their beers.

Contact Information:

  • Phone: (231) 498-2300

title: Bellaire Pub Menu
new_html:
Welcome to the Mothership — the original Short’s Brewing spot where great food, great beer, and Good Humans come together. What started as a hardware store in 2004 has transformed into a local favorite filled with love, good vibes, and delicious eats.

Popular Appetizers

  • Buffalo Chicken Dip with blue cheese crumbles
  • Nachos piled high with black bean corn salsa and cheese
  • House-made Mac n’ Cheese topped with toasted panko
  • Soft Pretzels served with mustard, jam, and cheese spread

Fresh Salads

  • Caesar with shaved Parmigiano and croutons
  • Chipotle BBQ Chicken with avocado and black bean salsa
  • Mixed greens with feta, falafel, and Greek dressing

Sammies & Sandwiches

  • Pulled Pork Sammie with Carolina BBQ and coleslaw
  • Adult Grilled Cheese with multiple cheeses and avocado
  • Classic grinders and corned beef on rye

Build Your Own Pizza & Specialty Pies
Handcrafted dough made with Local’s Light Lager — customize toppings or try favorites like house-made sausage, pulled pork, or mushroom festival.

Menu items change seasonally. Explore the full menu here: Bellaire Pub Food Menu

title: Seasonal Beers
new_html:
At Short’s Brewing, every season brings a fresh lineup of exciting beers crafted to celebrate the flavors and moods of the time of year. Whether it’s a crisp winter pilsner, a bright spring hazy IPA, or a refreshing summer shandy, these limited seasonal brews are only available for a short time — so stock up while you can!

Here’s a taste of what you might find rotating through the taps and cans:

  • The Pure Michigan series (Winter Pils plus Spring, Summer, and Fall IPAs)
  • Pure Michigan Porter
  • Only Tourists
  • Local’s Shandy
  • Rhuby

Discover current seasonal offerings here: https://www.shortsbrewing.com/beer-category/seasonal/

Available in cans and kegs, these seasonals showcase Short’s creativity and dedication to bold, flavorful beer all year round. Stay tuned and sip with the seasons!

title: Limited Releases
new_html:
Limited Releases

Welcome to the treasure trove of Short’s Brewing — the Willy Wonka vault of rare and one-time-only brews. When you spot these limited releases, grab them fast! Chances are, they won’t be around for long, making each sip a special experience.

Look for small-batch experimental beers, holiday and anniversary releases, ciders, and variety packs—many of them first poured at the Bellaire Pub.

See what’s out now: https://www.shortsbrewing.com/beer-category/speciality/

Available in cans, kegs, and variety packs, these limited editions showcase the creative spirit and adventurous flavors that keep Short’s fans coming back for more. Don’t miss your chance — these rare finds won’t last!

new_html:

Looking for a fun winter adventure? Try fat tire biking on snow at Shanty Creek Resorts! The 3km groomed multi-purpose trail at Schuss Village is designated for fat tire biking and snowshoeing, or simply a peaceful winter walk. title: Jordan River Pathway (East Jordan)
new_html:
Website: https://www.michigan.org/property/jordan-valley-pathway
Trailhead: Deadman’s Hill Scenic Overlook, Deadman’s Hill Rd, Elmira, MI 49730 (about 2 miles west of US-131, roughly 40 minutes from Bellaire)

A popular 18-mile loop trail through the Jordan River Valley in the Mackinaw State Forest, with a 3-mile loop and other shorter day-hike options available. Guests rave about the stunning river views, wildlife, and forest landscapes. Perfect for experienced hikers looking for a half-day hike or an overnight backpacking trip (camp at Pinney Bridge State Forest Campground near the halfway point). Hiking only—no bikes on the pathway.
